source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιος Ανδρέας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it prints no hymn and gives no year. The Greek calendar keeps a second company of companions of Stephen the New on 21 Οκτωβρίου, among them an Andrew the corpus already holds as `andrew-the-monk-martyr-of-crete`; that man is a monk of Crete who rebuked Copronymus to his face and was beheaded, and this one is an ascetic of a cell by Blachernae who was dragged to death, so two entries on two days are read here as two men.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (2 October 2026).
